_meta.fail_closed_behavior: When this file is empty (no entries) or malformed, the validator emits the lexicon_load_failed audit event at severity=critical and falls back to last-known-good in-memory state. If no last-known-good exists (cold start), _check_sensitive_lexicon() returns no violations (fail-open at the violation layer) but the audit event records the failure so the trust enforcer surfaces it. Lexicon entries are NEVER hardcoded in code per Gap D contract.

_authoring_instructions.block_patterns_format: Each list contains regex strings. Match (case-insensitive) against the response text. High-severity match = block + regenerate.
_authoring_instructions.warn_patterns_format: Each list contains regex strings. Match (case-insensitive) against the response text. Match = warn + log only, response not modified.
_authoring_instructions.user_state_gating_format: block_categories_in_states maps user_state -> list of block_pattern category names that are active in that state. Categories not listed for a state are inactive (no block, no warn from that category).
publish_workflow: 1. Clinician authors patterns in this file.
3. Commit + ship — file watcher hot-reloads on next request.
4. Verify via skyeye_activity for 'validator_lexicon_loaded' audit event with new schema_version.
